name: Dodge Everything
storyline: In the near future a defense AI is trained inside a virtual grid arena. Simple test avatars are spawned and targeted with endless patterns of projectiles so the system can learn how to eliminate anything that moves. You are one of these avatars, a tiny block of code that refuses to be deleted. The longer you survive, the more data you steal from the AI and the more dangerously it adapts to you.
summary: Dodge Everything is a fast-paced dodge arcade game where you control a tiny block and try to survive as long as possible while dodging endless projectiles. Collect power-ups, climb the highscore and unlock new levels and skins.
